CVE-2026-6230 is PUBLISHED and identifies unauthenticated time-based blind SQL injection through geoquery through version 1.0.3.

findings: The vulnerability mechanism, atomic first writer, immediate-parent absence, direct fix, and affected/fixed release topology independently reproduce the primary record.
The helper history contains only the BIC and direct fix, and its content is unchanged from the BIC through the fix parent, excluding an intervening vulnerable-line writer.
The primary NOT_AI conclusion overstates the available BIC-only evidence: empty trailers and a human-looking Git identity establish no detected AI marker, not affirmative human authorship.
